headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Luna rooftop bar is so loud!! They are way over for decibel limit!! Who even plays music this loud on a freaking Sunday??? I can hear the music over two sound machines and a box fan!

Completed. If we could get a few more seconds added to the northbound light it would really help. Other directions get full minutes. If we. Old get at least 10-20 seconds instead of 3 seconds then more than 2 cars could get through. Especially at 6-7 in the morning. Thank you!!
items.address: William Cannon and Pleasant Valley, Austin

items.text: Anderson High School students park in this no parking zone every day blocking the view to the right for anyone exciting from Mesa Village Condos making this a dangerous intersection. Please repaint the no parking yellow curb and start ticketing before there is an accident. Thank you!

Watr Rooftop at 96 Red River Street blasting loud music and heavy bass after 1 am, they even increased their volume  

This is a recurring disturbance, despite previous complaints and documented noise violations.

Pls just respond in the request and tell us what had been done so far? 
How many residents’ midnight compliant do we need for an action to be taken ?

This vehicle is currently parked in a clearly marked NO PARKING/TOW AWAY ZONE during daylight hours, although it typically parks overnight and leaves by sunrise. Unfortunately, I leave for work at night and need sufficient room to safely back out of my residential parking space without risking a collision. The narrow street and nearby utility pole already limit maneuvering space, and this vehic…

NOACN001. Summary: TPW - Obstruction in Right of Way - trash in median - S PLEASANT VALLEY RD & E RIVERSIDE DR
Details: Thank you for the service request, Obstruction has hazardous materials (needles) inside.

This road work safety stuff has been here for almost 6 weeks and hasn’t moved - and seems broken. I think maybe it’s been forgotten? If so, can it be removed please? My dog’s feet keep getting tangled in the netting when she goes potty in the grass there:)

Commercial vehicle and flatbed trailer parked overnight in accidental area… I have already reported this once, it looks like a citation is on the trucks windshield… the entire rig remains in spite of the violation as of 6:30 am this morning Monday Nov 2 — please address! Thank you

Watr DJ wayyyy over limits at 1:45. Can hear his words and music inside two blocks away at the modern, as if the party is in my unit. 
Please shut the business down for good. You’ve gotten over 20 complaints about this venue just tonight. If 311 can’t help, please tell who to report them to. Thanks.

Street sweeping services needed on bike lanes of Woodward near Home Depot all the way to Parker Lane. Also needed in bike lanes from Parker Lane intersection north to intersection with Oltorf Street. Nails, debris, broken glass bottles. Please do both streets. Don’t stop at one. I’ll just out in another request if you don’t do both of them.

These buttons were knocked loose last year and I submitted a complaint. I was told you no longer use these but then the city came and glued them back down again. Once again they are getting knocked loose and winding up in the bike lane. This is dangerous for bikers. Please stop installing these buttons.
Like ALWAYS pats pajamas and wiggle room BLASTING music.  And like ALWAYS we’re having to report them.  Can you please fine them? Send enforcement.  This is crazy we have to report them every night

WATR music can be heard loud and clear two blocks away. I understand that decibel readings on the sidewalk on the ground level may be ok, but please understand that it’s a rooftop venue and is above the decibel limit. Multiple neighbors have reported this issue tonight and previous nights.

It is 9:18 PM, and the pounding bass from Naya Restaurant continues to get progressively louder. The noise is clearly disturbing adjacent residences. I am concerned the venue may be rented out for private events without adequate sound supervision or enforcement of noise limits. Residents should not have to endure escalating bass noise inside their homes, especially at night when they need to sl…

NO JUMPING FROM BRIDGE signs have been vadalized/removed from the west end of pedestrian bridge over Barton Creek in Zilker Park. People illegally jump from the bridge on weekends. No one patrols this area to prevent jumpers. This is not on Barton Springs Road, it is the bridge North of Barton Springs Road.

I live in a B unit that faces a public alley. A few weeks ago the city came and removed a pole and street lamp from the alley and it’s now VERY dark. The lights from the street do not illuminate the alley at all. People walk through the alley with their pets and there are several homes. Please put the light back. The alley across from ours got a new pole and light at the same time, and we’d lik…

WATR increased their music. it's past midnight.it is even louder. I can hear it CLEARLY in my bedroom across the street. every single week. multiple times a week. this is ridiculous. they are a nuisance to the neighborhood.

There is a lot of sand and gravel due to recent roadway repairs. This is on the side street, Powell Street, and also along W. 5th St. roughly 1500 - 1504 block. The problem is cars driving over it kick up big clouds of dust, at times not even possible to walk the dog safely because of heavy dust clouds. Hoping street cleaners can come by soon!￼

My neighbors dog gets out at least twice a day week, it is out right now running around the neighborhood. It chased me from my car to my front door. I do not feel safe with that dog barking and growling at me for just going inside my house. This dog is aggressive and needs to be picked up

There is a homeless woman who legitimately lives at the entrance to the wishbone bridge. There is trash constantly everywhere, and she’s virtually reserved every bench in the small section that they exist, for her belongings. Several cops have visited our street this week due to her antics. You guys tried, and failed, to remove her and her belongings. Please do something effective about this. I…

I complain every year. After the city replaced the water lines nobody came to clean the mud. The street was not properly graded and huge puddles form with the slightest bit of rain. When they dry out several inches of mud remains. For once, please come clean up the mess the city left behind.

The traffic light on Texas Oaks and W Slaughter needs to be longer before the left turn signal to allow pedestrians to cross. Drivers are turning left while pedestrians have the right of way to cross. Pedestrians that have the right of way should not be forced to stop in the crosswalk to allow drivers to make the left turn.

Address 11339 Canterbury Tales.  Their is a small bulldog that keeps getting loose. it has now attacked atleast 3 dogs that we know of. This owner needs to be held responsible. i can provide contacts for atleast 2 owners and another witness. This dog is a threat to everyones animals.

Poor coyote dead in the middle of the road. Headed south bound on 360, the animal was after the Lost Creek intersection, before the light at Westbank/Scottish Woods Trail, on the U-turn across the street from and just north of the Westlake Fire Station.

items.text: Red vehicle blocking sidewalk. On Halloween. The time when KIDS NEED THE SIDEWALK TO AVOID WALKING IN THE ROAD

Westbound on E CESAR Chavez St before Shady Ln there is a row of delineators and two are damaged. 1st delineator is on ground and second is leaning and hitting the buses as the proceed through. Can these please be fixed.

Two dogs are loose in the neighborhood. One is a small white dog but the other is some kind of bull dog, I think? The bull dog attacked another person’s dog, and after they separated I tried to get close enough to read the collar but he got aggressive with me too, so I had to back away. They are clearly the same owners dogs running together. They were in and by the park and ran up the road with…

Watr Rooftop, 96 Red River St blasting music pass Midnight - Impossible to sleep with earplugs on even 
 
With so many prev reports, NOTHING was done - and they got even louder after midnight, I would say it again: NOTHING was done
Cats pajamas BLASTING MUSIC AND BASS like every f***ing time we report them,  how about for once you fine them,  TURN THE BASS DOWN.

Need maintence on stormwater inlets on 56th street near Ave H and need much better dust control at construction site. using leaf blower to move settled dust into dust cloud is exaggerating the issues. Need better dust control

Illegal construction truck parked daily in residential neighborhood, sometimes with trailer, at the corner of Vistas Drive and Arbor Crest. Safety concern being parked near corner making it harder to safely turn or cross Vistas Drive. Also concern for deteriorating road conditions, especially with area east of 35 with more mobile soils, due to continued parking/storage. Texas plate number: 1N19160

This unhitched RV/camper trailer (license plate B33 9102) remains parked on the residential street despite a previous Austin 311 report. The trailer is not attached to a towing vehicle and appears to have remained in the same location for an extended period. Requesting a follow-up inspection and appropriate parking enforcement, including removal if warranted.

A Chevy Trailblazer is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.

Just wondering if someone were to want to wreck havoc on the traffic control system in northwest Austin, would this make it easy for them. How many millions did we spend on the road expansion to not include a cover for this box?
